description: UNSEEN-style pack: new numbers, senders, wording, a mandatory generator, an irrelevant message
text:
From: Registrar's office, email, 4 Nov
Confirmed: a 5-hour hackathon for 120 students, teams of 4. Total budget is Rs 500,000 including everything. Eight staff will be on duty. A 20-minute prayer break is required. A standby generator is mandatory at the venue.

From: Skyline Venues, email, 1 Nov
Auditorium X seats 150 at Rs 90,000. Hall Y seats 250 at Rs 130,000. Hall Z seats 400 at Rs 210,000. Hall Y and Hall Z have a standby generator.

From: Royal Caterers, WhatsApp, 28 Oct
Biryani plate Rs 800 per head.

From: Royal Caterers, WhatsApp, 9 Nov
Assalam o alaikum! Biryani plate ab Rs 900 per head ka hai, aur basic lunch box Rs 650. Delivery Rs 5,000 alag se lagegi.

From: Jury secretary, email, 8 Nov
12 judges have confirmed. Each gets an honorarium of Rs 4,000. A judge needs 10 minutes per team and can cover at most four teams.

From: Accounts office, email, 6 Nov
Already paid from the event budget: banners Rs 15,000, trophies Rs 40,000.

From: Student council, WhatsApp, 10 Nov
Can we hire a photographer for the event? The quote is Rs 30,000.

From: Rahul (volunteer), WhatsApp, 11 Nov
Bhai kal ki cricket match ka score kya tha?
